# Codex PPT Slide Image Prompt

## Canvas

## Deck Goal
面向课程项目答辩，在 12–15 分钟内说清 Pandex SearchEngine 的离线建库、在线检索、推荐、缓存、工程优化、性能证据与改进路线。

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Pandex SearchEngine 是 C++ 实现的小型搜索引擎：离线构建中英文词典、字符索引、网页库、偏移库和 BM25 倒排索引；在线通过 TLV 和 HTTP 提供推荐与搜索，并使用 W-TinyLFU、Redis L2、singleflight、keep-alive 和 spdlog 提升工程质量。",
    "core_claim": "搜索效果由召回边界、排序质量和系统工程共同决定；正确语义、缓存策略、可观测性与对照实验同样是交付的一部分。",
    "canonical_terms": [
      "Pandex SearchEngine",
      "OR 召回",
      "BM25",
      "W-TinyLFU",
      "Redis L2",
      "singleflight",
      "HTTP keep-alive",
      "动态摘要",
      "UTF-8",
      "TLV"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "严格类名与关系：SearchServer→CachedSearchService；WebHttpServer→CachedSearchService；CachedSearchService→Cache/KeywordRecommender/WebSearcher；TwoLevelCache、ShardedWTinyLfuCache、RedisCache 实现 Cache；TwoLevelCache→ShardedWTinyLfuCache/RedisCache；WebSearcher→PageLibrary。关键字段可简化，类名和箭头不可改。"
  }
}

## Global Style
{
  "name": "高信息密度手绘白板风",
  "visual_direction": "真实温暖的浅米白白板，整洁黑色马克笔中文，蓝红橙绿少量标注；像优秀算法老师边画边讲，亲和但不幼稚。每页 2–4 个信息区加 1 个结论区，比样张适度增加节点、数据与旁注。",
  "color_palette": "warm off-white #FAFAF5; black marker main text; blue #3498DB structure; red #E74C3C conclusions and risks; orange #F39C12 metrics; green #27AE60 successful paths; yellow sticky notes #FFF3A6",
  "typography": "large neat handwritten Chinese marker titles, compact but clearly legible handwritten body text, accurate Latin technical terms and formulas; no cursive ambiguity",
  "texture_and_finish": "clean photographed whiteboard surface with subtle eraser traces, marker strokes, restrained sticky notes and hand-drawn arrows",
  "density_rule": "moderately high density; use the full 16:9 canvas; keep minimum readable body text; prefer small diagrams, matrices and callouts over long paragraphs",
  "layout_variation": "vary composition by slide role: panorama, dual pipeline, matrix, timeline, comparison, chart evidence, roadmap and Q&A; avoid repeating one three-card template"
}

Use Image 1 as the approved sample-slide style reference. Match its palette, typography mood, density, texture, and overall visual identity. Do not copy its exact layout unless this slide's layout explicitly asks for it.

## Input Image Handling Rules
For any input image marked as a strict input asset, include it visibly and preserve its content. Do not redraw, replace, relabel, or invent a similar figure. Scale and crop only as needed for composition while keeping the important labels, arrows, data, and relationships recognizable.
